subject: Physics
topic: Work, Energy & Power: Conservative Fields & Potential Wells
title: Grade 9 Olympiad Work, Energy & Power Conceptual Ontology & Dependency Graph

structural_pillars.name: The Work Dot-Product Invariant
structural_pillars.statement: Work is the scalar line integral of force along the path of displacement. Only force components collinear with instantaneous displacement contribute to work. Perpendicular forces perform identically zero work.
structural_pillars.scope_condition: Holds for all forces in classical mechanics; work is a scalar invariant under coordinate rotations.

structural_pillars.name: Universal Work-Energy Theorem (WET)
structural_pillars.statement: The net work done by all forces (conservative, non-conservative, internal, and external) acting on a body equals the exact change in its kinetic energy.
structural_pillars.mathematical_invariant: W_{\text{net}} = \sum_{i} W_i = \Delta K = \frac{1}{2}m v_f^2 - \frac{1}{2}m v_i^2 = \frac{p_f^2 - p_i^2}{2m}
structural_pillars.scope_condition: Valid in any Newtonian inertial frame; applies to both constant and continuously varying forces.

structural_pillars.name: Conservative Field Path-Independence & Closed-Loop Vanishing
structural_pillars.statement: A force is conservative if and only if the line integral around any closed loop vanishes. The work done between two spatial configurations depends strictly on the endpoints, independent of the intervening trajectory.
structural_pillars.scope_condition: Applies to static gravitational, ideal elastic spring, and electrostatic fields; fails for dissipative friction or viscous drag.

structural_pillars.name: Potential Energy Negative Gradient Identity
structural_pillars.statement: Potential energy U is defined exclusively for conservative interactions as the negative of work done. Force always drives the physical system toward lower potential energy configurations.
structural_pillars.scope_condition: Potential energy belongs to the interaction between parts of a system; requires explicit declaration of a datum U = 0.

structural_pillars.name: Mechanical Energy Conservation & Dissipative Friction Ledger
structural_pillars.statement: When non-conservative forces act, the change in total mechanical energy (K + U) equals the non-conservative work. When non-conservative work is zero, mechanical energy is strictly conserved.
structural_pillars.mathematical_invariant: \Delta E_{\text{mech}} = \Delta(K + U) = W_{nc} = -\int f_k\,ds \le 0, \quad W_{nc} = 0 \implies K_i + U_i = K_f + U_f
structural_pillars.scope_condition: Requires an enclosed system boundary where internal potential energies are accounted for and non-conservative boundaries are monitored.

cognitive_conflict_matrix.intuitive_misconception: Because centripetal force is large and maintains circular motion, it must do positive work on the rotating mass.
cognitive_conflict_matrix.newtonian_scientific_truth: Centripetal force acts perpendicular to instantaneous velocity (F_c perp v). Since cos(90 deg) = 0, centripetal force performs strictly zero work, changing only direction while leaving kinetic energy invariant.
cognitive_conflict_matrix.decisive_experiment: A satellite in a circular orbit travels for billions of years under continuous gravitational centripetal pull without losing or gaining speed.

cognitive_conflict_matrix.intuitive_misconception: An object at height h possesses an absolute intrinsic potential energy of mgh regardless of the coordinate system.
cognitive_conflict_matrix.newtonian_scientific_truth: Potential energy has physical meaning only through differences Delta U = -W_c. The datum U = 0 is an arbitrary coordinate convention; physics is invariant under any constant shift U -> U + C.
cognitive_conflict_matrix.decisive_experiment: A book on a 1-meter table inside a 3rd-floor classroom: calculating the work done when dropping it to the floor yields the identical Delta K whether datum is ground floor, classroom floor, or table.

cognitive_conflict_matrix.intuitive_misconception: A higher-power machine always performs more total work than a lower-power machine.
cognitive_conflict_matrix.newtonian_scientific_truth: Power is the rate of doing work (P = dW/dt). A 1000 W engine operating for 1 second performs 1000 J; a 50 W bulb running for 1 hour performs 180,000 J. Work is total energy; power is temporal delivery rate.
cognitive_conflict_matrix.decisive_experiment: Comparing a 1000 W dragster engine revved for 2 seconds (2000 J) versus a 200 W human cyclist pedaling steadily for 1 hour (720,000 J).

cognitive_conflict_matrix.intuitive_misconception: Work to stretch a spring by distance x is F * x = (kx) * x = kx^2.
cognitive_conflict_matrix.newtonian_scientific_truth: Spring force increases linearly from 0 to kx. The work is the triangular area under the F-x line: W = int_0^x kx' dx' = 0.5 * k * x^2 (half the bounding rectangle).
cognitive_conflict_matrix.decisive_experiment: Calibrated force-displacement sensor: integrating the triangular area under Hooke's law curve F = kx yields exactly 0.5 * k * x^2.

cognitive_conflict_matrix.intuitive_misconception: Friction always performs negative work on every body it touches.
cognitive_conflict_matrix.newtonian_scientific_truth: Kinetic friction performs positive work on a secondary object that is accelerated forward by it (e.g. box placed on moving conveyor belt, top block accelerating with bottom cart). Only the net sum of work on both surfaces combined is non-positive.
cognitive_conflict_matrix.decisive_experiment: Placing a stationary box on a moving conveyor belt: kinetic friction accelerates the box from rest to belt speed, doing positive work Delta K = +0.5 m v^2 on the box.

cognitive_conflict_matrix.intuitive_misconception: Two objects with identical momentum must possess identical kinetic energy.
cognitive_conflict_matrix.newtonian_scientific_truth: K = p^2 / (2m). For equal momentum, kinetic energy is inversely proportional to mass. The lighter body has vastly greater velocity and therefore carries vastly greater kinetic energy.
cognitive_conflict_matrix.decisive_experiment: Firing a rifle: rifle and bullet have equal and opposite momentum (p_bullet = -p_rifle). However, bullet mass m << rifle mass M, so bullet absorbs over 99% of the powder's kinetic energy.
